question: Is cereal a soup?
summary: An argument that returns to social feeds every few months: does a bowl of cereal in milk count as soup?

sideA.label: Yes, soup
sideA.position: Solid pieces in a liquid, served in a bowl and eaten with a spoon.

sideB.label: Not soup
sideB.position: Soup is savoury and usually cooked; cereal is neither.

sources.title: Community-submitted summary of the recurring debate
sources.claim: Supporters say anything with solids in a liquid, eaten from a bowl with a spoon, qualifies as soup.

sources.title: Community-submitted summary of the recurring debate
sources.claim: Opponents say soup must be savoury and served as a meal course, which rules cereal out.

uncertainty: There is no official authority that defines soup for this purpose.
